2: Iemand die geen opleiding heeft gevolgd maar wel met een kettingzaag kan werken.

ENGLISH
 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 

We’re looking for someone who would like to assist us one or more days a week as a flex worker.
 

Our work mainly consists of pruning and felling trees.
 

We’re looking for two types of candidates:
 

1: Someone who has already completed training in arboriculture and knows the basics of pruning and felling trees.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.
